name: Arcane Lock
description:
You touch and magically seal a door, gate, window, chest, or other object that can be closed. Roll Spirit to set the spell’s Difficulty.

You and any creatures you designate when casting the spell may open the object normally. You may also set a password. Speaking the password while within short range of the object suppresses the spell for 1 minute.

For all other creatures, the object cannot be opened normally. To attempt to force it open, they must roll Strength against the Difficulty. On a pass, the spell ends and the object opens.

Describe how you cast the spell.
